meta._v1_0_delta: v1.0 was authored against an inferred UIL convention (emoji as decorative key glyph) taken from ontology_v18.json. That inference was WRONG: uil_vocab.yaml defines 176 ASCII uppercase base glyphs, each carrying a latex symbol field, and uil_sorts.yaml defines the 6-sort type system. v1.1 removes the emoji field entirely and adds sort annotations. No PH content was retracted; four quantum entries added.
meta.isolation: Axiom I/I'-analogue, WEAKENED AND DECLARED. meta[] carries administrative references (host parenthesis id, blocking defect ids, promotion target) so the file's status is legible from inside. PH[] carries NONE: no PH value references any record in any other file. Warrant direction is one-way — nothing in the corpus may infer from a PH entry. This is a WEAKER claim than doctrine_v1.json's 'cites nothing'; stated as weaker rather than overclaimed.
meta._isolation_grounds: Isolated to prevent warrant leak (Composition: parts true therefore whole true), NOT for unfalsifiability. Every PH entry is externally checkable against a published result. This file's epistemic status therefore DIFFERS from doctrine_v1.json despite near-identical barrier text. Do not merge the two sinks or treat them as one class.
meta.orientation: CONSTRAINT ONLY. A PH entry states what a formalism CANNOT do, never what any formalism may claim. No PH entry may serve as warrant for any F, M, D, E, P, C, CX, AI, N, R or X record. Every entry in this file is a NEGATIVE result: a bound, an impossibility, a forced form, or a required precondition. An entry that licenses something is inadmissible and must be rejected at PROPOSE.
meta._uil_conformance: Conforms to uil_sorts.yaml (6 sorts, two tiers) and uil_grammar_v1.yaml. Introduces NO new base glyph, NO new composite glyph, NO new constructor, NO new sort. uil_vocab.yaml base_glyphs is stability:fixed_point and uil_constructors.yaml is addition_only with permanence — a constraint sink has no business extending either. PH entries are therefore SORT-ANNOTATED ONLY: they are classified by the existing system, not admitted into its vocabulary.
meta._sort_rule: Use-based per uil_sorts.yaml. Quantity where the entry's primary use is to COMPUTE a number. Proposition where the primary use is to CHECK a condition. No entry is Entity or Procedure by construction: a constraint file references no things and invokes no computations. Current distribution: 8 Proposition, 2 Quantity.
meta._symbol_discipline: TWO reserved sets, both spelled out in ASCII here, neither used as a symbol. (1) Host variable glyphs — rho, beta, kappa, sigma, lambda, epsilon, theta, Gamma, delta — reserved by ontology_kernel_v18.md and master-system.md pending a symbol registry. (2) UIL constructor symbols — the apply, ratio, measure, entail, attest, compose, restrict, quantify, conjoin and disjoin operators of uil_constructors.yaml — which carry OPERATIONAL SEMANTICS and dispatch. A constructor symbol appearing in a PH value would be a live parse hazard, not a documentation ambiguity. Neither set appears anywhere below. Symbol collision unreachable by construction; this file requires no registry to exist first.
meta._key_rule: ASCII ids of form PH-NNN. No emoji, no ZWJ, no glyph of any kind. Conforms to host meta._key_rule (v10) and to the uil_grammar identifier production.
meta._value_schema: PH: name · sort · statement · constraint · source · warrant
meta._quantum_scope: ADMITS, and the admitted set is deliberately ALL NEGATIVE: CHSH/Tsirelson bounds (PH-001), non-commutative order effects and the QQ equality (PH-006), Gleason's forcing of the probability rule (PH-007), Kochen-Specker contextuality (PH-008), no-signalling (PH-009), and the Holevo capacity bound (PH-010). Quantum probability is Hilbert-space MATHEMATICS, not physics — Busemeyer & Bruza 2012 are explicit that no physical quantum process in the brain is claimed or required. EXCLUDES: superposition, entanglement, decoherence, wavefunction collapse, observer-effect and quantum indeterminacy used as social, epistemic or organisational metaphor. Any proposed entry requiring physical quantum mechanics as WARRANT is inadmissible; entries that CONSTRAIN such claims are the whole point.
meta._quantum_rationale: The quantum block is the largest in the file and this is intentional, not drift. Each of PH-007 through PH-010 closes a specific metaphorical escape route: Gleason removes the option of adopting Hilbert-space structure with a bespoke probability rule; Kochen-Specker raises the evidential bar for any contextuality claim above mere order effects; no-signalling kills 'quantum connection as influence at a distance'; Holevo kills 'quantum representation carries more information'. A sink whose job is absorbing quantum metaphor is STRENGTHENED, not diluted, by holding more of the results that refute it.
meta._excluded: Non-exhaustive list of material this file exists to ABSORB AND REFUSE rather than route onward: Noether/conservation as governance metaphor · thermodynamic entropy as social disorder · relativity as perspectivism · uncertainty principle as epistemic humility · field theory as network theory · holography as emergence · entanglement as rapport · collapse as decision · E=mc2 as anything at all. Each is zero-severity under the host severity definition (nobody would bet against it) and carries high reception-risk. Absorbing these here rather than into F[] or CX[] is this file's PRIMARY function. The file is an attractor, not a capability.
meta._promotion_path: PH entries are candidates for promotion into the host F[] section. Promotion is BLOCKED by two open defects: D-020 (host symbol collision — PH-003, PH-004 and PH-007 concern quantities the host denotes with collided glyphs) and D-042 (UIL constructor/operator symbol collision). On both closing and a no-free-collision assertion passing at build, PAR-08 discharges and eligible entries move to F[] under the F value schema, carrying their sort annotations. Until then NO PH entry is load-bearing anywhere.
meta._sizing: Cap REVISED from 10 to 12, and the revision is declared rather than taken silently. v1.0 declared 6 entries final; v1.1 holds 10. The growth is entirely the quantum block (PH-007..PH-010) and is justified in _quantum_rationale — all four are negative results that tighten containment. That justification does NOT extend to further growth: additions beyond 12, or any addition that is not a negative result, are the signal that physics-shaped material is winning and should trigger review rather than a version bump. Two slots remain.
meta._review_status: Authored across two sessions, unreviewed. No decorrelated reviewer has checked the statements, the sources, the sort assignments or the constraint framings. Treat every entry as unverified until independently checked against the cited source. n_eff for this file is 1.0.

PH.PH-001: chsh_tsirelson_bound · Proposition · For two parties with binary outcomes and two measurement settings each, the CHSH combination S = E(a,b) - E(a,b') + E(a',b) + E(a',b') (one of several equivalent sign conventions) satisfies |S| <= 2 under any local hidden-variable model, and |S| <= 2*sqrt(2) ~ 2.828 under quantum mechanics · CONSTRAINT: a claim that some social, epistemic or organisational correlation is quantum-like in the entanglement sense requires |S| > 2 measured on a preregistered protocol. No known social or cognitive system exceeds 2. Absent that measurement the claim is unsupported, and any archetype or role definition invoking observer-dependent reality on quantum grounds fails here · Clauser, Horne, Shimony & Holt 1969 (PRL 23:880); Tsirelson 1980; Hensen et al 2015 (Nature 526:682, loophole-free) · W1
PH.PH-002: causal_set_order_number · Proposition · A causal set is a locally finite partially ordered set: transitive, acyclic, with every order interval finite. Sorkin's result, order plus number equals geometry, is that the causal order alone determines the Lorentzian metric up to a conformal factor, with the counting measure supplying the missing volume element · CONSTRAINT: the recovery theorem REQUIRES transitivity, acyclicity and local finiteness jointly. A binary relation lacking any one of the three is not a causal set and inherits none of the recovery results, however structurally similar it appears. A relation admitting cycles is specifically excluded; in the spacetime reading a cycle is a closed timelike curve · Bombelli, Lee, Meyer & Sorkin 1987 (PRL 59:521); Malament 1977 (J Math Phys 18:1399) · W1
PH.PH-003: er_isolated_vertex_density · Quantity · In the directed random graph G(n,p), the probability that a given vertex has in-degree zero is (1-p)^(n-1). With n*p tending to a constant c, the expected fraction of in-degree-zero vertices tends to exp(-c), and the isolated-vertex count is asymptotically Poisson · CONSTRAINT: any counted ratio of zero-in-degree nodes is uninformative without a stated null model. This entry supplies one such null; it does not supply the only one, and a measured ratio that matches the null is evidence of nothing in particular. No null, no inference · Erdos & Renyi 1959 (Publ Math Debrecen 6:290) and 1960; Bollobas 2001 ch.3 · W1
PH.PH-004: er_giant_component_threshold · Quantity · G(n,p) undergoes a phase transition at critical edge probability 1/n. For n*p < 1 the largest component is O(log n); at n*p = 1 it is of order n^(2/3); for n*p > 1 a unique giant component of size proportional to n emerges · CONSTRAINT: connectivity regimes are NOT continuous in edge density, so a regime typology indexed on an edge-density ratio must declare whether its boundaries are the percolation thresholds or stipulated cut-points. The two do not coincide, and a typology that silently assumes continuity will misclassify near the transition · Erdos & Renyi 1960; Bollobas 2001; Janson, Luczak & Rucinski 2000 · W1
PH.PH-005: dimensional_homogeneity · Proposition · Every physically meaningful equation is homogeneous in its dimensions. Buckingham: a relation among n quantities involving k independent dimensions reduces to a relation among n-k dimensionless groups · CONSTRAINT: the cheapest inspection instrument available, and decidable without domain knowledge. Both sides of any declared threshold comparison must carry identical dimensions, and any quantity compared against a stipulated constant must share that constant's unit. A comparison whose two sides differ in dimension is malformed regardless of the numbers involved · Buckingham 1914 (Phys Rev 4:345); Bridgman 1922 · W1
PH.PH-006: noncommutative_order_effects · Proposition · Where P(A then B) differs from P(B then A), no classical Kolmogorov measure models the pair, because classical conjunction commutes. Projections on a Hilbert space do model it, since non-commuting projectors are order-sensitive by construction. The QQ equality is the parameter-free prediction: for two binary questions asked in both orders, [P(Ay,Bn) + P(An,By)] - [P(By,An) + P(Bn,Ay)] = 0 · CONSTRAINT: this is measure theory, not physics, and the distinction is load-bearing. No physical quantum process is claimed or required. A system exhibiting order effects licenses the non-commutative formalism and licenses NOTHING FURTHER — in particular no entanglement, no superposition, and no observer-dependent ontology · Busemeyer & Bruza 2012; Wang & Busemeyer 2013 (Top Cogn Sci 5:689); Wang, Solloway, Shiffrin & Busemeyer 2014 (PNAS 111:9431) · W1
PH.PH-007: gleason_born_forcing · Proposition · On a separable Hilbert space of dimension at least 3, every measure on the lattice of closed subspaces has the form trace(W times P) for a positive semi-definite trace-class operator W of unit trace. The probability rule is not an added postulate; it is forced by the lattice structure. The theorem FAILS in dimension 2, which is why the dimension condition is stated · CONSTRAINT: adopting Hilbert-space structure for a cognitive or social model means adopting its probability rule as well. A model that helps itself to non-commuting projections and then substitutes a bespoke scoring rule is not the quantum formalism and inherits none of its results. Formalism adoption is package-deal, not a menu · Gleason 1957 (J Math Mech 6:885); Busch 2003 for the POVM extension · W1
PH.PH-008: kochen_specker_contextuality · Proposition · On a Hilbert space of dimension at least 3, no assignment of definite pre-existing values to all observables is both non-contextual — independent of which commuting set the observable is measured alongside — and consistent with the functional relations among those observables. Finite explicit sets of vectors admitting no such assignment are known · CONSTRAINT: contextuality is a STRICTLY STRONGER claim than order-sensitivity. Demonstrating that measurement order changes outcomes (PH-006) does not demonstrate contextuality; that requires exhibiting an inconsistent value assignment over a commuting structure. Any claim of contextuality in a social or epistemic system must meet the stronger bar or be restated as the weaker one · Kochen & Specker 1967 (J Math Mech 17:59); Bell 1966; Cabello et al 1996 for minimal vector sets · W1
PH.PH-009: no_signalling · Proposition · For a bipartite quantum state, the reduced state of one party is unchanged by any local operation performed by the other. Local marginal statistics are therefore independent of the distant party's measurement setting, and no correlation however strong permits transmission of information · CONSTRAINT: entanglement is a correlation, not a channel. The metaphor of quantum connection as influence, coordination-at-a-distance, or non-local causation is refuted by the formalism it borrows from, not merely unsupported by it. This constraint holds even where PH-001 is violated: super-classical correlation and signalling are independent properties · Ghirardi, Rimini & Weber 1980 (Lett Nuovo Cimento 27:293); Peres & Terno 2004 (Rev Mod Phys 76:93) · W1
PH.PH-010: holevo_capacity_bound · Quantity · The classical information accessible from an ensemble of quantum states is at most the Holevo quantity, the von Neumann entropy of the ensemble average minus the average of the component entropies. For n qubits this is at most n bits · CONSTRAINT: quantum representation confers no capacity advantage in classical information transmitted per carrier. A claim that a quantum-style encoding of beliefs, preferences or states carries more information than its classical counterpart is bounded above by the classical count. Where quantum methods help, it is in computation or in correlation structure, never in raw channel capacity · Holevo 1973 (Probl Peredachi Inf 9:3); Schumacher & Westmoreland 1997; Holevo 1998 · W1
